title: [sample] json.dumps fails on Decimal values from my price feed
author: sample-reporter
body:
When I serialize prices that come from `decimal.Decimal`, `json.dumps` blows up.

```python
import json
from decimal import Decimal

prices = {"apple": Decimal("0.99"), "pear": Decimal("1.25")}
print(json.dumps(prices))
```

I expected `{"apple": 0.99, "pear": 1.25}`.

Docs I read: https://docs.python.org/3/library/json.html

My environment, in case it matters:

```
PYTHON_VERSION=3.13.1
GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_FAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKE1234
PRICE_FEED_URL=https://prices.example.org/feed
```
